{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|If Kreuge had only swept farther with the right wing at Salvara instead of turning when he did, the whole history of the Tenuutta Skirmishes would be different!|A historian|<ref name="GM Screen">''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Screen, Revised]]''</ref>}}
The '''Tenuutta Skirmishes''' were a series of conflicts<ref name="GM Screen" /> in the [[Tennuutta sector/Legends|Tennuutta sector]]<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the Tenuutta Skirmishes|system=the Tennuutta sector}}</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Guide">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']] and ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' both state that the [[Battle of Salvara]] took place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].</ref> The [[Battle of Salvara]] was part of the Tenuutta Skirmishes.<ref name="GM Screen" />
